name: Out Of Stock Badge
author: Irish_Cathal

sections.description:
Out Of Stock Badge adds a simple, customisable Out of Stock badge to WooCommerce products.

The free functionality includes:

  • Automatic Out of Stock badge
  • Custom badge text
  • Background colour
  • Text colour
  • Live admin preview

Advanced functionality is built into the same plugin and can be unlocked with a valid Arrow Design licence purchased from:
https://arrowdesign.ie/product/out-of-stock-badge-advanced-functionality/

Advanced functionality currently includes:

  • Low Stock badges
  • Backorder badges
  • Sale badges
  • Global badge positioning
  • Font, padding, radius, offset and opacity controls
  • Shop, category/tag, search and single-product display controls
  • Option to hide the standard WooCommerce Sale badge
  • Per-product badge overrides
  • Custom per-product badges

The plugin checks an activated Advanced licence approximately once per week. A previously validated licence can continue temporarily if the licence server cannot be reached. If the paid entitlement is no longer valid, Advanced functionality is disabled but settings are retained and the free Out of Stock badge remains available.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to WordPress or install it from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is active.
  4. Go to Settings > Out Of Stock Badge.
  5. Configure the free badge, or purchase Advanced Functionality and enter the supplied licence key.
sections.faq:
Do I need a licence for the basic Out of Stock badge?

No. The basic Out of Stock badge remains free.

Do I need to install a separate Pro plugin?

No. Advanced functionality is built into the same plugin and unlocks after licence activation.

What happens if my Advanced licence expires?

Advanced features stop running, but their saved settings are retained. The free Out of Stock badge continues to work.

  • Advanced features unlock immediately after successful licence activation.
  • Retains Advanced settings if entitlement later expires.
  • Migrates settings and licence data from the separate Pro development build where present.
  • Added Low Stock, Backorder and Sale badges to the licensed Advanced mode.
  • Added Advanced styling, display controls and per-product badge overrides.

2.4.0

  • Added purchase links for Advanced Functionality.
  • Kept the WordPress.org edition focused on the free Out of Stock badge.

2.3.0

  • Refocused the free edition on Out of Stock badge functionality only.
